svg.title: Commander Companion canonical compact and rules translation
svg.desc: A visual art-direction board translating the approved cinematic dark-fantasy, antique-gold and luminous-teal reference into the compact score screen, rules sheet and motion language.

g.text: CANONICAL UI TRANSLATION · COMPACT SCORE + RULES + MOTION
Continuous reading surface · gold numbering · scenic anchors
Una guida rapida ai punteggi mostrati dall’app.
Ogni giocatore inizia con 40 punti vita.
Con 0 o meno punti vita, un giocatore perde.
10 o più segnalini veleno causano la sconfitta.
Richness from typography, atmosphere and linework—not from more controls
Display serif for identity and values · Inter for utility and copy
Ivory inactive · gold active · teal magical state
Use the existing 140/220ms system; add one-shot light cues, never choreography
220ms in · 140ms out · edge line illuminates once
No transform, draw, bloom or drift
